products_used_grade_chk.name: products_used_grade_chk
products_used_grade_chk.value: "products"."condition" <> 'USED' or "products"."status" in ('DRAFT') or "products"."used_grade" is not null

seller_orders_completion_chk.name: seller_orders_completion_chk
seller_orders_completion_chk.value: "seller_orders"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' or ("seller_orders"."receipt_basis" is not null and "seller_orders"."funds_released_at" is not null)

seller_orders_entitlement_chk.name: seller_orders_entitlement_chk
seller_orders_entitlement_chk.value: "seller_orders"."status" not in ('DELIVERED','COMPLETED') or "seller_orders"."receipt_basis" is not null

seller_reviews_rating_chk.name: seller_reviews_rating_chk
seller_reviews_rating_chk.value:
"seller_reviews"."rating" between 1 and 5
        and ("seller_reviews"."delivery_rating" is null or "seller_reviews"."delivery_rating" between 1 and 5)
        and ("seller_reviews"."packaging_rating" is null or "seller_reviews"."packaging_rating" between 1 and 5)
        and ("seller_reviews"."accuracy_rating" is null or "seller_reviews"."accuracy_rating" between 1 and 5)
        and ("seller_reviews"."communication_rating" is null or "seller_reviews"."communication_rating" between 1 and 5)

conversations_binding_chk.name: conversations_binding_chk
conversations_binding_chk.value:
("conversations"."context" = 'SELLER_ORDER' and "conversations"."seller_order_id" is not null and "conversations"."order_id" is not null and "conversations"."seller_id" is not null and "conversations"."deal_id" is null and "conversations"."seller_user_id" is null)
       or ("conversations"."context" = 'DEAL' and "conversations"."deal_id" is not null and "conversations"."seller_user_id" is not null and "conversations"."seller_order_id" is null and "conversations"."order_id" is null and "conversations"."seller_id" is null)

payout_channel_configs_cost_chk.name: payout_channel_configs_cost_chk
payout_channel_configs_cost_chk.value: "payout_channel_configs"."cost_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "payout_channel_configs"."cost_fixed" >= 0 and "payout_channel_configs"."cost_min" >= 0 and ("payout_channel_configs"."cost_max" is null or "payout_channel_configs"."cost_max" >= "payout_channel_configs"."cost_min")

pricing_versions_maker_checker_chk.name: pricing_versions_maker_checker_chk
pricing_versions_maker_checker_chk.value: "pricing_versions"."approved_by" is null or "pricing_versions"."validated_by" is null or "pricing_versions"."approved_by" <> "pricing_versions"."validated_by"

pricing_versions_published_chk.name: pricing_versions_published_chk
pricing_versions_published_chk.value: "pricing_versions"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' or ("pricing_versions"."effective_from" is not null and "pricing_versions"."approved_by" is not null and "pricing_versions"."published_by" is not null)
